notes: Stop signatures for LinkedIn pages (design 4.5). Every regex is matched case-insensitively against the field it names (url, title or text) and uses only syntax that Python re and JavaScript RegExp read the same way: no inline flags, no lookbehind, no named groups. A signature matches when its regex matches or the HTTP status is listed. 'trip': true trips reason_code's breaker. error_after_click lists page errors that make gate unknown record failed_after_click.
